instruction: Go to the Chrome downloads page to view your recent download history.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to Chrome downloads page. Uses existing is_expected_active_tab_approximate metric to check if the active tab URL matches chrome://downloads/. Similar complexity to original task - single navigation action to Chrome internal page.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator correctly verifies the single requirement (navigate to chrome://downloads/)
Correct getter logic: get_active_url_from_accessTree extracts URL from Chrome address bar via accessibility tree
Correct metric logic: is_expected_active_tab_approximate strips query parameters and compares base URLs for exact match
Correct expected value: chrome://downloads/ is the proper Chrome internal URL for downloads page
State accessibility: Address bar URL persists after navigation, no postconfig needed
Semantically sound: The evaluator can reliably verify that the user navigated to the Chrome downloads page
